logger.doc:name: Log System Layer Execution
logger.message: #['[LAYER: SYSTEM] Executing DB Select (Request ID) | CorrelationID: ' ++ (vars.correlationId default '')]

db:select.doc:name: Select Order by Request ID
db:select.db:sql: SELECT order_id, status FROM orders WHERE request_id = :reqId

logger.doc:name: Log System Layer Execution
logger.message: #['[LAYER: SYSTEM] Executing DB Insert (New Order) | CorrelationID: ' ++ (vars.correlationId default '')]

db:insert.doc:name: Insert Order (ACCEPTED)
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO orders (order_id, customer_id, customer_email, currency, order_total, payment_method, payment_ref, status, request_id, correlation_id, accepted_at) VALUES (:orderId, :customerId, :customerEmail, :currency, :orderTotal, :payMethod, :payRef, 'ACCEPTED', :requestId, :correlationId, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{ 'orderId': vars.orderId, 'customerId': vars.incomingPayload.customer.customerId, 'customerEmail': vars.incomingPayload.customer.email, 'currency': vars.incomingPayload.currency, 'orderTotal': vars.incomingPayload.orderTotal, 'payMethod': vars.incomingPayload.paymentMethod, 'payRef': vars.incomingPayload.paymentReference, 'requestId': vars.requestId, 'correlationId': vars.correlationId }]

db:insert.doc:name: Insert order_items
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO order_items (order_id, sku, product_name, quantity, unit_price, tax_rate_percent, line_total, line_status) VALUES (:orderId, :sku, :name, :qty, :price, :tax, :total, 'PENDING')
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{ 'orderId': vars.orderId, 'sku': payload.sku, 'name': payload.productName, 'qty': payload.quantity, 'price': payload.unitPrice, 'tax': payload.taxRatePercent, 'total': payload.lineTotal }]

db:select.doc:name: Query Line Items
db:select.db:sql: SELECT sku, quantity, line_status FROM order_items WHERE order_id = :orderId

db:select.doc:name: Check Processed Message
db:select.db:sql: SELECT jms_message_id FROM processed_messages WHERE jms_message_id = :msgId

db:update.doc:name: Conditional Stock Update
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE inventory_stock SET available_qty = available_qty - :qty, reserved_qty = reserved_qty + :qty, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE sku = :sku AND available_qty >= :qty

db:update.doc:name: Update line to RESERVED
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE order_items SET line_status = 'RESERVED', reserved_qty = :qty WHERE order_id = :orderId AND sku = :sku

db:update.doc:name: Update line to BACKORDERED
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE order_items SET line_status = 'BACKORDERED', reserved_qty = 0 WHERE order_id = :orderId AND sku = :sku

logger.doc:name: Log System Layer Execution
logger.message: #['[LAYER: SYSTEM] Executing DB/File Ops (Invoice) | CorrelationID: ' ++ (vars.correlationId default '')]

db:insert.doc:name: Insert Invoice Metadata
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO invoices (invoice_number, order_id, invoice_date, taxable_amount, tax_amount, payable_total, file_path, archive_path, generated_at) VALUES (:invNum, :orderId, CURRENT_DATE, :taxable, :tax, :payable, :path, :archive, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{ 'invNum': vars.invoiceNum, 'orderId': vars.orderId, 'taxable': round((vars.orderData.orderTotal / 1.18) * 100) / 100, 'tax': vars.orderData.orderTotal - (round((vars.orderData.orderTotal / 1.18) * 100) / 100), 'payable': vars.orderData.orderTotal, 'path': vars.invoiceFileName, 'archive': vars.archivePath }]

db:update.doc:name: Update Order to Fulfilled
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE orders SET status = :status, invoice_number = :invNum, fulfilled_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE order_id = :orderId

db:insert.doc:name: Insert processed_messages
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO processed_messages (jms_message_id, consumer_name, order_id, processed_at) VALUES (:msgId, 'fulfilment-consumer', :orderId, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

logger.doc:name: Log System Layer Execution
logger.message: #['[LAYER: SYSTEM] Executing SMTP Email | CorrelationID: ' ++ (vars.correlationId default '')]

db:update.doc:name: Set notified_at
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE orders SET notified_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE order_id = :orderId
